raw_text:
RESHMA PILLAI 
Data Analyst 
Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala  ·  reshma.pillai@example.com  ·  94950XXXXX 
CAREER OBJECTIVE 
Data analyst with 5 years of experience turning raw operational and sales data into dashboards, forecasts, and 
reports that drive decisions for retail and FMCG clients. Strong in SQL, Python, and Power BI, with a track 
record of automating manual reporting workflows and presenting findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
CORE COMPETENCIES 
Technical: SQL (advanced), Python (pandas, NumPy), Power BI & DAX, Excel (advanced, VBA), Statistical 
analysis, ETL pipelines 
Interpersonal: Stakeholder communication, Data storytelling, Requirement gathering, Cross-team collaboration 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Senior Data Analyst — Insight Analytics Pvt Ltd, Thiruvananthapuram 
Jun 2023 – Present 
▸ Own 12 recurring Power BI dashboards used weekly by regional sales leadership 
▸ Automated a manual weekly reporting process, saving the team roughly 6 hours per week 
▸ Built a demand-forecasting model that reduced stockouts for a key FMCG client by 18% 
▸ Present monthly insights directly to client VPs, translating data trends into action items 
Data Analyst — DataCore Solutions, Kochi 
Jan 2021 – May 2023 
▸ Cleaned and validated survey datasets of 50,000+ responses for market research clients 
▸ Wrote complex SQL queries to aggregate data across 3 disparate source systems 
▸ Supported the monthly reporting cycle for the operations and finance teams 
▸ Built the team's first standardized data-quality checklist, cutting rework by 30% 
Junior Data Analyst — MetricWorks Analytics, Kochi 
Aug 2019 – Dec 2020 
▸ Assisted senior analysts with data cleaning and Excel-based reporting for 6 client accounts 
▸ Learned and applied SQL fundamentals to support ad hoc data pulls 
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS 
▸ Built a self-serve dashboard template later adopted as the company standard across all analyst teams 
▸ Reduced a client's month-end close reporting time from 3 days to 4 hours through automation 
EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS 
B.Sc, Statistics — Kannur University (2016 – 2019), 8.1 CGPA 
Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate (2022) 
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (2023) 

VOLUNTEER EXPERIENCE & LANGUAGES 
Languages: English (fluent), Malayalam (native) 
▸ Volunteer data-literacy trainer, local NGO weekend workshops (2022 – present)
